sections.title: The Concept: From ODEs to PDEs
lecture_lines: ODEs involve a single independent variable.
PDEs depend on multiple variables like space.
animations: Display central concept: ODE vs PDE transition using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/particle.svg].
Highlight PDE dependency on multiple variables.
Visualize spatial and temporal dimensions using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ripple.svg].

sections.title: Visualizing the Domain
lecture_lines: We visualize PDEs as fields or surfaces.
The vertical axis represents our dependent variable.
We seek surfaces satisfying specific constraints.
animations: Highlight sub-regions within the domain using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/surface.svg].
Show discretization of the spatial domain using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/domain.svg].

sections.title: The Diffusion Equation (Heat Equation)
lecture_lines: The heat equation models diffusion processes.
It tracks how quantity spreads over time.
Heat flows from high to low concentration.
Gradient changes show this evolution clearly.
Observe how temperature smooths out eventually.
animations: Display Heat Equation formula using #FFD700 with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/thermometer.svg].
Highlight derivative components of the equation.
Summarize the diffusion process visually using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ice.svg].

sections.title: Boundary and Initial Conditions
lecture_lines: PDEs require constraints for unique solutions.
Initial conditions define the starting state.
animations: Show initial heat state distribution using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/thermometer.svg].
Visualize boundary condition effect on flow.

sections.title: Synthesis and Summary
lecture_lines: PDEs are the language of physics.
They allow predicting complex physical systems.
Operators link math to real-world change.
